scientific_integrity: An explicit infinite proof is supplied. Exact finite computations confirm local coefficients and the convolution; finite testing does not certify the asymptotic or originality.
scientific_limitations: Established only for k=3 and fixed reduced residue classes. Error O_{q,eps}(x^(1/3+eps)) is not claimed sharp. More general earlier convolution estimates might imply parts implicitly; independent mathematical validation is absent.
title: A square-root quadratic-character bias in weighted ternary divisor means
